{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mk 2e/S laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] combat-modified [[XP-38 sport landspeeder]]s were usually armed with Mk 2e/S laser cannons.<ref name="MBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref> A [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Alliance [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] made use of a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] mounted with a Mk 2e/S laser cannon.<ref name="Bazaar">{{WEGCite|story=A Bazaar Encounter|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>
